# `assertion_04`

The same OM `property_assert` diagnostic path as `assertion_03`, one commit later and a different bug: having found the message operand's defining `om.constant`, the code cast that constant's value straight to `mlir::StringAttr`, so a message whose constant is a non-string parameter attribute (`#hw.param.verbatim<"P">`) trips `cast<Ty>() argument of incompatible type!` instead. It is in the set for what it proves about 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 rather than for a class the other four do not cover. `assertion_03` and this fixture are **two distinct upstream bugs with two distinct fixes** whose `fingerprint_frame` is character-for-character identical, `verifyResult ElaborateObject.cpp`, and whose signal is the same `SIGABRT`: had either been a `crash` or a `fatal_error`, whose primary fingerprint is exactly `signal + fingerprint_frame`, G-44's "distinct" would have merged them into one. What separates them is the assertion basis, and only the assertion basis: the expressions differ (`detail::isPresent(Val) && "dyn_cast on a non-existent value"` against `isa<To>(Val) && "cast<Ty>() argument of incompatible type!"`) and so do the sites (`Casting.h:656` against `Casting.h:560`). The pair is therefore also a ready-made labelled **R4** entry for 04-Test-Plan.md 10's dedup set, labelled here before any fingerprint was computed for it.

Mined by `analysis/measurements/w09_attempt.sh` on 2026-09-14 from seed `56f16468bccf` (`test/Dialect/OM/elaborate-object-errors-unevaluated.mlir`), observed at its first parent `4ac632ae7dd8` built against `firtool-1.156.0`; the same input at the seed commit does not fire. Tool `circt-opt`, class `assertion`, signal `SIGABRT`.

`stderr.txt`, `expected.json:assertion_site` and the frame paths carry the mining host's build prefix (`/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/wt156` for CIRCT sources, `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.156.0` for the SDK), not the image's `/workspace/circt/` and `/opt/circt-sdk/`. 03-LLD.md 3.7.1 strips the build prefix before the site enters a fingerprint, so the prefix is evidence and never a compared value; the relative site is `/home/adi/.cache/chia-pin-smoke/w09/sdk-1.156.0/include/llvm/Support/Casting.h:560`.
